Spam n Cheese

2 boxes of Mac n cheese

1 large can of spam

1 can cream of mushroom soup

1 can of corn or peas

Milk

Butter

Shredded cheese optional

Make Mac n cheese normally.

As the Mac n cheese is cooking warm cream of mushroom soup in separate pot. Add a can full of milk. Once its not clumpy, add in can of corn or peas. Cube spam and toss that in there as well.

After Mac n cheese is done mix both together.

Add shredded cheese if you want to.

Depends on how low on money. And if we're talking about food for a night or like a week. I'll go w a several days of food for one(you might get a week out of it if you eat small, and do like PB&J for lunch). Salsa Chicken: A slow cooker recipe, so it's easy as F as well.
1 package chicken breasteses.
1 can corn drained
1 can black beans
1 jar salsa of choice
Put chicken into crock pot, and then all the other stuff on top of chicken. Cook on low for 4 hours. Shred chicken. Serve over rice. Top w shredded cheese if you can afford that. And other stuff (sour cream, hot sauce) if you can afford that.

You'll be eating left overs for a minute. But it's cheap, easy, tasty, and nutritious. I eat it even when I'm not broke.
